description: Verify that DUT-emitted ARP Announcements have sender_proto_ip == target_proto_ip == announced Link-Local address (RFC 3927 §2.4, MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
The Announcement is a self-claim: by setting both sender_proto_ip and target_proto_ip to the same address (the LL DUT just claimed), DUT signals 'I am the owner of this IP'. RFC 3927 §2.4 mandates this exact shape so receivers update their cache to map LL → DUT_MAC.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpStartLLAutoconf (kicks the Link-Local state machine)

2. DUT: 3 Probes → Announcement(s).

3. Observation:
   • DUT → wire: ARP Announcement
     - sender_proto_ip == target_proto_ip == announced LL   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Announcement has sender_proto_ip == target_proto_ip == announced LL.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_announce_sender_target_ip_mismatch — Announcement sender_proto_ip ≠ target_proto_ip, or one of them is not the announced LL
• Fail_no_announce_after_probes — DUT did not emit any Announcement after the Probe phase

verdicts.Pass: Announcement sender_proto_ip == target_proto_ip == announced LL — normal
verdicts.Fail_announce_sender_target_ip_mismatch: Announcement sender_proto_ip / target_proto_ip is not the announced LL
verdicts.Fail_no_announce_after_probes: DUT did not emit any ARP Announcement after Probes
